notes.what: 337 invented real-estate search queries with a language-based intent label (browsing / researching / high_intent_inquiry). 60 come from Week 1 (source=week1), 277 were written for Week 7 (source=week7).
notes.guidelines: docs/intent_guidelines.md (written before the Week 7 queries were labeled).
notes.annotator: single annotator (the AI assistant that also wrote the classifier). A blind relabel of 80 queries agreed 80/80, which shows the rules are applied consistently by one labeler, not that another person would agree.
notes.splits: near-duplicate groups (same wording apart from city and numbers) stay in one split; seed 707. train 55% / dev 20% / test 25% per label.
notes.not_real_traffic: queries are invented, not collected from users. No MLS data, so this file can be committed.
notes.added_after_first_dev_run: 43 extra training-only queries (source=week7_added) written after the first dev run to cover thin phrasing styles (short keyword-style high-intent queries, short topic queries). Any candidate within 0.6 token overlap of a dev or test query was dropped. Dev and test were not changed.
